picks.what: View of the city with the Cathedral of Our Lady of the Sign, engraving (detail)
picks.who: Andrei Ukhtomsky after a drawing by I. Rambauer
picks.why: the only early general view; cathedral and the Noble Assembly building recognizable; dark frame line at top trimmed

picks.file: Kursk, view, Red Synagogue and White Synagogue.jpg
picks.why: labeled “Kursk No. 9, general view”; town spread over the hill with the monastery cathedral on the skyline; caption trimmed

gaps: P0–P2: nothing; P5: only railroad station postcards (about 1915) and a 1921 poster; the 1913 view covers it; P6: kept the 2020 aerial view (new candidates are a snowy field panorama and a water tower)
notes: #3 is the file’s own enlarged detail of the 1821 Ukhtomsky engraving; the cathedral was under construction 1816–26, so the engraving may show it as designed. #3 is only 1747 px wide and grayish but sharp enough. #4 (1782) is a town plan, #2 a single-building elevation, both skipped.
